method: Production GCP endpoint; generated 24 kHz mono PCM16, six repeated sentences. Deliberately ignored one storage acknowledgment, replayed its chunk, and disconnected for six seconds while capture time continued.

physical_live_transcription.input: generated PCM through the real phone-to-production queue; not human microphone speech

physical_microphone_and_playback.method: Continuous real microphone capture, two generated 0.5-second speaker tones; verified mixer output, not acoustic loudness. Restart both engine and player after hardware configuration changes.

limitations: Final playback retention and speaker route reassertion were added after the passing 20-second physical test; compiled successfully but longer final device run blocked by phone disconnect.
Live GPT-Live audio forwarding has no provider per-chunk acknowledgments. Durable full-utterance file transcription is authoritative for Codex.
Transcription remains probabilistic; byte-exact ingestion does not guarantee every recognized word.
Five-minute local pending-audio limit stops recording visibly instead of evicting old chunks.
Long uninterrupted speech is transcribed in 30-second fragments; Codex waits for a pause or end of call.
Pending external action with unknown completion is not automatically re-executed.
No sustained simultaneous camera upload and human speech recognition test was completed in this device session.
audio_engine_findings: Initial physical engine could stop after a hardware format change without a thrown start error.
Restarting the engine alone captured microphone audio but left playback silent; resetting the player before restarting restored measured playback.
Final build explicitly selects built-in speaker and microphone and retains uncompleted playback across graph resets. A partially played chunk may repeat after a reset.
